# Volante Tower II

> Volante II is an ultra-luxury residential tower on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, rising 36 storeys above two basement parking levels. It holds a deliberately small number of large apartments, laid out to take canal, city and Burj Khalifa views. Residents' facilities include a private cinema, a club lounge, a spa and gym, and an outdoor terrace overlooking the water, reached through a double-height lobby.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2026

## MENASCO Scope

Volante II is an ultra-luxury residential tower on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, offering a limited collection of high-end residences with views towards Burj Khalifa. MENASCO executed the complete MEP works, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and low-current systems, with chilled water, smart-building controls and integrated life-safety solutions supporting long-term comfort and operational efficiency.
